thread:
Maria: Neptune Analytics needs an ephemeral capacity surge for a POC demo next Tue. Requesting guaranteed +3x capacity on a dedicated pool in eu-west-1 for ~48h. Also need hosted API keys scoped to the pool and VPC peering prep. Who can own autoscale + pricing + security checklist?

Josh: I can take autoscale + pricing. Quick Qs: exact peak RPS, avg seq len, and do they require guaranteed reserve or is best-effort burst ok?

Maria: Peak ~1.5k reqs/min, avg seq ~512 tokens. They prefer guaranteed reserve for the demo (can't risk evictions).

PoolOps: We have capacity in eu-west-1. Guaranteed reserve means we need a short-term capacity reservation (billable). If they want best-effort, we can enable burst credits with soft-evict for 72h. Tagging @PoolOps to confirm GPU footprint.

PoolOps: Confirmed — we can provision a temporary reserved pool equivalent to 8 A100s for the window. Need exact start/end timestamps and a billing PO or CC on-file for the pro-rated reservation. Otherwise we can do soft-burst credits.

Maria: Sales wants a fast quote for the customer to sign. Can finance share a ballpark for 48h reserved 8x A100 equiv?

Ravi: Ballpark: $24/hr per GPU. For 8 GPUs -> $192/hr. For 48h that's $9,216, plus a one-time $300 setup/ops fee. Send them $9.5k estimate and note final invoice may vary slightly.

Sam: Security heads-up: we'll need the completed security questionnaire before granting VPC peering. Required items: customer AAD/OAuth service account, encrypted KMS key (customer-managed ok), allowed IP ranges for the peering tunnel, and a signed data addendum (SOC2). Also want confirmation no sensitive PII will be sent during demo.

Maria: Customer can sign the addendum. They asked if we can issue an API key limited to the POC and expiring after the demo window.

Alice: Yes — we can create a scoped API key tied to the dedicated pool with TTL via the console. For Dedicated we recommend a service account + short-lived token for workers. Example autoscale/burst policy to apply: 

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 10
  burst_policy:
    reserved_gpus: 8
    mode: guaranteed
    cooldown_seconds: 900
```

Alice: Note: the runtime will honor `reserved_gpus` and block other traffic when active, so be sure the customer knows this will be billed as reserved capacity.

PoolOps: To proceed we need: region=eu-west-1, start=2026-03-24T08:00:00Z, end=2026-03-26T08:00:00Z (confirm?), billing contact or PO number, and the pool name to attach the API key to. Also provide the VPC CIDR and desired peering window.

Maria: Proposed window above is what the customer requested, yes. Billing contact = billing@neptune-analytics.com; PO pending but they can CC a card for immediate provisioning. Pool name: neptune-poc-eu1. VPC CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16.

Sam: For peering we'll need the customer's ASN and preferred tunnel endpoints. I'll DM a short checklist (firewall rules, route table entries, KMS policy sample).

Ravi: I'll prepare the estimate email with the $9.5k figure and the optional soft-burst alternative (no PO required) and share a payment link.

Josh: Once PoolOps confirms availability and security signs off, I can create the scoped API key and a runbook for the customer with example client config, e.g.:

```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=neptune-poc-xxxxx
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-open-7b-quant","input":"hello"}' \\\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/instances/neptune-poc-eu1/generate
```

PoolOps: Marked as tentative. I'll schedule the provisioning job once we have PO or card on file and security checklist complete. ETA to provision (after approvals) = ~2 hours.

Maria: Great — locking this thread. I'll coordinate signatures and ping when PO/card are in. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
